title: TapHound generation observe --json Output
description: Reference shape for the JSON result of `generation observe --json`. snapshotRef is the authoritative project-relative snapshot evidence path. With --compact, snapshot is omitted and the agent reads snapshotRef before constructing the next proposed-step envelope.

snapshotRef.description: Authoritative project-relative RuntimeSnapshot evidence path. Active sessions use the Store-owned .<generationId>.work bundle; publication atomically moves the same evidence to the final <generationId> bundle.

snapshot.description: Full RuntimeSnapshot. Omitted only when --compact is used. See proposed-step-envelope.json $defs/RuntimeSnapshot for the detailed schema.

windowHierarchy.description: Conservative comparison between visible touchable target-app windows and semantic layout roots. An incomplete status must block proposal generation.
